# core:fuel

The deterministic cost of a region of a test.

[`measure`] runs a closure and, under `wado test --report-fuel`, reports
the fuel it spent: about one unit per Wasm instruction the guest ran. Fuel
does not depend on the host, so one run gives a figure that only a change to
the program or to wasmtime moves. It leaves out what the host does for the
guest, GC included, and it prices every instruction alike.

Without `--report-fuel` the closure just runs. Only `wado test` supports
it, and a program for any other world that reaches this module does not
compile.

## Synopsis

```wado
let n = builtin::black_box(1_000);
let sum = measure("sum", || {
    let mut s = 0;
    for let i of 0..<n {
        s += i;
    }
    return s;
});
assert sum == 499_500;
```

## Functions

### `pub fn measure<T, effect E>(label: String, mut f: fn mut() -> T with E) -> T with E`

`#[benign(FuelHost)]`

Runs `f` and reports the fuel it spent as region `label` of the running
test. `f`'s result passes through `builtin::black_box`, so the work that
produces it is never optimized out of the region.
